title: Drazil and Factorial
statementMd:
Drazil is playing a math game with Varda.

Let's define ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7020b94c48be2ee5b8eeca05f379c8911bb0e7c4.png) for positive integer $*x*$ as a product of factorials of its digits. For example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6784d861d9a724d0aeddefcb00b7d0c3442ae586.png).

First, they choose a decimal number $*a*$ consisting of $*n*$ digits that contains at least one digit larger than $1$. This number may possibly start with leading zeroes. Then they should find maximum positive number $*x*$ satisfying following two conditions:

1. $*x*$ doesn't contain neither digit $0$ nor digit $1$.

2. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7020b94c48be2ee5b8eeca05f379c8911bb0e7c4.png) = ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa57e017a6c74d06b0a54bc47e3f6990e5af38c1.png).

Help friends find such number.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 15$) — the number of digits in $*a*$.

The second line contains $*n*$ digits of $*a*$. There is at least one digit in $*a*$ that is larger than $1$. Number $*a*$ may possibly contain leading zeroes.

## Output

Output a maximum possible integer satisfying the conditions above. There should be no zeroes and ones in this number decimal representation.

## Note

In the first case, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f5a4207f23215fddce977ab5ea9e9d2e7578fb52.png)
statementZhMd:
Drazil 正在和 Varda 玩一个数学游戏。

对于正整数 $*x*$，我们将 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7020b94c48be2ee5b8eeca05f379c8911bb0e7c4.png) 定义为其各位数字的阶乘之积。例如，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6784d861d9a724d0aeddefcb00b7d0c3442ae586.png)。

首先，他们选择一个由 $*n*$ 位数字组成的十进制数 $*a*$，其中至少有一位数字大于 $1$。这个数可能以若干个前导零开头。然后，他们需要找出满足以下两个条件的最大正整数 $*x*$：

1. $*x*$ 既不包含数字 $0$，也不包含数字 $1$。

2. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7020b94c48be2ee5b8eeca05f379c8911bb0e7c4.png) = ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa57e017a6c74d06b0a54bc47e3f6990e5af38c1.png)。

请帮助这两位朋友找出这样的数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 15$）——$*a*$ 的位数。

第二行包含 $*a*$ 的 $*n*$ 位数字。$*a*$ 中至少有一位数字大于 $1$。数 $*a*$ 可能包含前导零。

## 输出格式

输出满足上述条件的最大整数。其十进制表示中不应包含数字 $0$ 和 $1$。
